## Wan 2.7 API

Wan 2.7 is a text to video, image to video, reference to video and video editing model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `wan-2-7-text-to-video`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Wan 2.7 is Alibaba's video model, served uncensored, for high-fidelity text-to-video in 5-, 10- or 15-second clips at up to 1080p. It can follow an audio track you provide.

### Wan 2.7 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wan-2-7-text-to-video` | Text to video | Anonymized | from $0.11 / sec |
| `wan-2-7-image-to-video` | Image to video | Anonymized | from $0.11 / sec |
| `wan-2-7-reference-to-video` | Reference to video | Anonymized | from $0.11 / sec |
| `wan-2-7-video-to-video` | Video edit | Anonymized | priced by source |

Clip prices for `wan-2-7-text-to-video`, silent:

| Duration | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|
| 5s | $0.55 | $0.70 |
| 10s | $1.10 | $1.40 |
| 15s | $1.65 | $2.10 |

### Wan 2.7 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Alibaba Qwen |
| Released | Apr 2, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |

| Durations | 5s, 10s, 15s |
| Aspect ratios | 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 |
| Audio | None |

### How to use the Wan 2.7 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "wan-2-7-text-to-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "wan-2-7-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "wan-2-7-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
